headline: Name each action before it happens
subtext: “Download My Data” and “Delete Account” tell recipients what each button will do, while a plain warning marks deletion as permanent.
image_alt_text: A Hush Line social graphic titled “Name each action before it happens.” It shows the light-mode Advanced settings page, where separate buttons read “Download My Data” and “Delete Account.” A warning says that deleting the account is permanent and cannot be undone.

social.bluesky: Serious choices need specific labels. Hush Line’s Settings page says “Download My Data” and “Delete Account,” with a clear warning that deletion cannot be undone. That helps journalists and lawyers sharing sensitive intake confirm the intended action during a handoff.
social.linkedin:
“Continue” is a poor label for a permanent choice.

Hush Line’s Settings page names each button for what it does: “Download My Data” and “Delete Account.” The delete section also states that the action cannot be undone.

For journalists and lawyers sharing sensitive intake, exact labels reduce guesswork during account maintenance. A colleague can identify the intended task before selecting a button.

During your next handoff, refer to the action by name so everyone knows what will happen.
social.mastodon: Buttons for serious choices should say exactly what they do. In Settings, Hush Line uses “Download My Data” and “Delete Account,” then warns that deletion cannot be undone. For journalists and lawyers sharing sensitive intake, that wording makes a handoff easier to verify. Refer to the action by name when a colleague takes over.

rationale: The only candidate is a documented cooldown fallback, so this plan avoids prior angles about export storage, retention, testing, and separating risky controls. It instead explains the visible use of specific action labels, giving recipient teams a concrete way to reduce ambiguity during handoffs.
copy_brief: Write for recipients and staff using Hush Line day to day, not for platform admins.

editorial_intent.label: Recipients and staff
editorial_intent.reader_need: Help a recipient or staff member improve a repeatable sensitive-intake workflow.
